claim.claim-text: 1. An agricultural composition comprising a bacterial isolate of Paenibacillus or Bacillus, wherein the bacterial isolate is fermented and/or cultured in a culture medium comprising BS3, BS3-M2, BS3-M9, BS3-M10, GB6-M, GB6-M3, GB6-M7, GB6-M8, GB6-M9, GB6-M22, GB6-M23, GB6-M10, GB6-M31, GB6-M33, or GB6- M34.

2. The agricultural composition of claim 1, wherein the culture medium comprises BS3-M2, BS3-M9, BS3-M10, GB6-M, GB6-M3, GB6-M7, GB6-M8, GB6-M9, GB6-M22, GB6-M23, GB6-M10, GB6-M31, GB6-M33, GB6-M34, or combination thereof.
3. The agricultural composition of claim 1 or 2, wherein the culture medium comprises GB6-M10, GB6-M31, GB6-M33, GB6-M34 or combination thereof.
4. The agricultural composition of claim 1, wherein the bacterial isolate is fermented by a process that comprises:
(1) inoculating the bacterial isolate in a seed medium and (2) expanding the culture with a production medium.

5. The agricultural composition of claim 4, wherein the seed medium comprises LB, TSB, BS3, BS3-M2, BS3-M9, BS3-M10, GB6-M, GB6-M3, GB6-M7, GB6-M8, GB6-M9, GB6-M22, GB6-M23, GB6-M10, GB6-M31, GB6-M33, GB6-M34, or combination thereof.
6. The agricultural composition of claim 4, wherein the production medium comprises GB6-M10, GB6-M31, GB6-M33, GB6-M34, or combination thereof.

7. An agricultural composition comprising a bacterial isolate of Paenibacillus or Bacillus, wherein the bacterial isolate is fermented and/or cultured in a culture medium comprising (i) 5-20 g/L Soy peptone, 2-10 g/L Urea, 0-5 g/L CaCl<2>, 2-10 g/L KH<2>PO<4>, 2-10 g/L K<2>HPO<4>, and 10-30 g/L Sucrose; (ii) 10-30 g/L low fat soy flour, 1-5 g/L CaCl<2>, 2-10 g/L KH<2>PO<4>, 2-10 g/L K<2>HPO<4>, and 10-30 g/L Sucrose; (iii) 5-30 g/L maltodextrin, 5-25 g/L Dextrose, 1-10 g/L yeast extract, 0.1-5 g/L ammonia sulfate, and 0.2-3 g/L CaCO<3>; (iv) 5-40 g/L maltodextrin, 5-20 g/L Dextrose, 2-15 g/L yeast extract, 2-15 g/L low fat soy flour, 0.2-1.5 g/L Ammonia sulfate, and 0.5-3 g/L CaCO<3>; or (v) 5-20 g/L low fat soy flour, 0.5-5 g/L CaCl<2>, 2-10 g/L KH<2>PO<4>, 2-10 g/L K<2>HPO<4>, 10-30 g/L Sucrose, and 0.1-5 g/L ammonia sulfate.
